card.title: FLIPIT · Deal alerts · NJ / PA / DE

vo_lines: Every foreclosure sign you drive past... is somebody's deal.
Tax liens. Auctions. Foreclosures. All public records.
Then fills your letter of intent, cash purchase agreement and assignment.
Scan the code. Find your first flip.

end.tagline: Find the deal. Fill the forms. Flip it.
end.fine: Not a broker, lender or law firm. Have an attorney review contracts.

caption: Every foreclosure sign you drive past is somebody's deal. FLIPIT finds tax-lien and foreclosure deals from public records, then fills your letter of intent, cash purchase agreement and assignment from one entry. Scan the QR to sign up, or go to flipit-m5ig.onrender.com (link in bio).
